value.name: Miles signs the pre-nup
value.description: Miles argues that the Massey pre-nup can still be executed after marriage and then signs it himself.
evidence: MILES You know... there's nothing in the Massey pre-nup that says it can't be executed after the parties wed.
He decisively clicks the button on a ballpoint pen, looks down at the paper in front of him and scribbles his name.

value.name: Miles offers the signed agreement to Marylin
value.description: After signing, Miles pushes the pre-nup across the table toward Marylin, inviting her response.
evidence: He pushes the paper across the table toward Marylin.

value.name: Marylin silently weighs Miles's sincerity
value.description: Marylin studies Miles's face for the truth before taking the paper, showing the emotional stakes of the moment.
evidence: Gazing at him, seeking the truth in his eyes, she absently picks up the paper.
Marylin however, looks only at Miles.

value.name: Marylin tears up the pre-nup
value.description: Marylin rejects the agreement by ripping the paper in half, signaling a reversal in her stance.
evidence: Marylin rips the paper in half.

value.name: Ruth ends the meeting
value.description: Ruth dismisses the situation as settled and announces she is leaving for the office.
evidence: RUTH (bored) O-kay. I'm going back to the office

value.name: Ruth comforts Wrigley
value.description: Ruth tries to cheer up the distraught Wrigley by offering him a drink and medication.
evidence: RUTH Come on Wrigley, I'll buy you a drink and an anti depressant.

value.name: Wrigley laments being unloved
value.description: Wrigley reacts melodramatically, saying no one will ever love him that way.
evidence: WRIGLEY No one will ever love me that way.

value.name: Ruth dismisses Wrigley's despair
value.description: Ruth responds with a cutting joke, undercutting Wrigley's self-pity.

value.name: Miles and Marylin reconcile
value.description: Miles and Marylin rise toward each other and kiss, choosing each other over separation.
evidence: Miles rises slowly to his feet.
He puts his knuckles on the tabletop and leans forward.
Marylin rises slowly to his feet.

value.name: Miles asks to go home
value.description: After kissing Marylin, Miles signals that they should leave together.
